description: This file defines the RBUS class, which provides an RPC interface for managing RBUS operations, including connection handling, data elements, sessions, component discovery, get/set operations, and command handling. It also declares relevant methods and external dependencies.

classes.name: RBUS
classes.description: A class providing RPC interfaces for RBUS operations, inheriting from RDKTestStubInterface and AbstractServer<RBUS>. It binds multiple methods for RBUS control and data management.
